This is a full-time position open exclusively to Saudi nationals. The role involves supervising and coordinating electrical engineering activities to ensure project compliance and timely task completion. Key Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate all electrical engineering activities within projects. Review electrical drawings and technical specifications to ensure accuracy and adherence to standards. Ensure full compliance with project requirements and established safety standards. Coordinate effectively with various project teams to facilitate the timely completion of assigned tasks. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering is required. A valid registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) is mandatory for this position. Previous experience in electrical engineering is essential. b3e8e7b31c5a2488.description: About the Role SO/ Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Director of People & Culture to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires a Saudi National with over 10 years of experience. The Director will serve as a strategic partner to the Executive Team, focusing on talent, culture, and leadership to enhance the workplace environment and employee experience. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the People & Culture strategy, ensuring alignment with the company's vision and values. Lead initiatives for talent attraction, development, and retention through recruitment and growth programs. Cultivate a culture that promotes engagement, inclusion, and belonging. Oversee employee experience, wellbeing, and recognition programs to support performance. Collaborate with leaders to improve organizational effectiveness and team success. Ensure adherence to Saudi labor laws, Saudization requirements, and company policies. Utilize people insights and workforce data for strategic decision-making. Manage and develop the People & Culture team. Advise the Executive Team on matters related to people, culture, and organizational structure. Ability to act as a strategic partner to executive leadership. Benefits and Development The role offers opportunities for career progression within a global network of brands. b302183dcb19885b.description: About the Role Alfanar is seeking a Consolidation & Reporting Specialist to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting financial consolidation and reporting across multiple entities, ensuring compliance with IFRS, maintaining system accuracy, and providing timely financial analysis. The specialist will also contribute to audit processes and initiatives aimed at improving financial reporting workflows. Key Responsibilities Participate in monthly, quarterly, and annual financial consolidation processes across various entities. Prepare consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS requirements. Execute intercompany reconciliations and resolve any identified discrepancies. Maintain and update consolidation systems and tools, such as Prophix, and monitor data accuracy and system performance. Contribute to internal management reporting and external financial disclosures, including support for variance analysis and financial performance reporting. Coordinate with divisional finance teams to ensure timely and accurate data submission, and communicate reporting requirements and timelines. Prepare audit documentation and respond to auditor inquiries, ensuring alignment with audit standards and internal control procedures. Participate in initiatives focused on improving reporting efficiency and accuracy, and identify areas for enhancement in consolidation and reporting workflows. Role Accountabilities Maintain updated soft and technical skills relevant to the job. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets according to delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time parameters. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Solve arising problems and escalate complex operational issues as needed. Ensure quality requirements are met to develop effective quality control and processes. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, and procedures, seeking automation opportunities. Comply with relevant policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within the defined area of work. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience in financial consolidation and reporting. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

b33315ad34f9412d.description: About the Role SMART Technology Solutions is seeking a Customer Success Specialist (Trainee) to join our team in Riyadh or Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on client retention and relationship management for a portfolio of Smart Services clients. The objective is to ensure clients derive measurable value from their purchased services, leading to renewals and expansion opportunities. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Client Portfolio and Services The Customer Success Specialist will manage a portfolio of clients ranging from PIF-backed entities and government authorities to private financial services firms, law practices, and consultancies across Riyadh and Jeddah. As the single named point of accountability, the Specialist will oversee client relationships from contract signing through renewal and potential expansion. SMART Technology Solutions delivers services across seven lines: IT Management, Technical Projects, Application Development, Digital Products, Cybersecurity, Business Applications, and Procurement. Key Capabilities Commercial Judgement: Ability to assess client accounts and differentiate between satisfied clients and those at risk of churn. Written Discipline: Consistent and clear documentation in both Arabic and English. Comfort with Senior Stakeholders: Capability to conduct business reviews with client executive sponsors, focusing discussions on outcomes rather than support tickets. Technical Literacy: Sufficient understanding of the seven service lines to identify expansion opportunities and facilitate communication between clients and delivery teams. Escalation Courage: Proactive identification and direct reporting of issues. Follow-through: Ensuring all meetings conclude with confirmed next steps, assigned owners, and subsequent execution of those steps. Advantageous Qualifications While not strictly required, candidates with the following experience or qualifications may have an advantage: Background in IT managed services, systems integration, or technology consulting. Prior exposure to public sector procurement cycles within Saudi Arabia. Formal customer success certification or training. Experience in establishing a customer success function from its inception. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh or Jeddah. The role emphasizes building and maintaining strong client relationships to ensure long-term success and value realization from SMART Technology Solutions' services.

b36b27407a48ac73.description: مطلوب مدير استراتيجية التسويق والعلامة التجارية مقر العمل : الرياض , حي الملك فيصل نبذة عن الوظيفة تعلن شركة ويست ستوري، المتخصصة في حلول التعطير والأجهزة والزيوت العطرية، عن رغبتها في استقطاب مدير استراتيجية التسويق والعلامة التجارية يتمتع بفكر استراتيجي وإبداعي وخبرة عملية في بناء العلامات التجارية وتوسيع انتشارها . نبحث عن قائد تسويقي قادر على وضع وتنفيذ استراتيجية متكاملة تهدف إلى تعزيز شهرة العلامة التجارية، وزيادة حضورها في السوق السعودي، وقيادة فريق التسويق لتحقيق أهداف الشركةوصناعة استراتيجية تسويقية واضحة، وابتكار أفكار تحقق انتشاراً واسعاً، وبناء علامة تجارية قوية يتذكرها الجمهور . المهام والمسؤوليات إعداد استراتيجية تسويقية سنوية وخطط تنفيذية ربع سنوية وشهرية تتوافق مع أهداف الشركة . تطوير وتنفيذ خطط زيادة الوعي بالعلامة التجارية (Brand Awareness) وتعزيز مكانتها في السوق . قيادة فريق التسويق الحالي، وتوزيع المهام، ومتابعة التنفيذ وتقييم الأداء . ابتكار الحملات التسويقية والإشراف على تنفيذها عبر القنوات الرقمية وغير الرقمية . إعداد استراتيجية المحتوى التسويقي والإشراف على تطوير الأفكار الإبداعية والرسائل الإعلانية . تخطيط وإدارة التعاون مع المؤثرين وصناع المحتوى والعلاقات العامة والشراكات التسويقية . تطوير استراتيجيات تسويق منتجات الشركة للأفراد (B2C) وحلول التعطير للقطاع التجاري (B2B). دراسة السوق والمنافسين، وتحليل سلوك العملاء واكتشاف فرص الانتشار والنمو . إعداد الميزانيات التسويقية المقترحة وتوزيعها على القنوات والحملات ومراقبة كفاءة الإنفاق . قياس مؤشرات الأداء التسويقي، بما يشمل الوعي بالعلامة التجارية، والوصول، والتفاعل، ونمو الطلب، وتقديم تقارير دورية للإدارة العليا . المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في التسويق، منها سنتان على الأقل في إدارة التسويق أو قيادة الفرق . خبرة مثبتة في بناء العلامات التجارية وتنفيذ حملات تهدف إلى زيادة شهرتها وانتشارها . معرفة قوية بالسوق السعودي وسلوك المستهلك والقنوات التسويقية المؤثرة فيه . القدرة على إعداد الخطط والاستراتيجيات التسويقية وتحويلها إلى برامج تنفيذية قابلة للقياس . خبرة في إدارة الحملات المتكاملة والمؤثرين والعلاقات العامة والتسويق الرقمي . مهارات قيادية وتنظيمية عالية، والقدرة على إدارة فرق متعددة التخصصات . إجادة تحليل النتائج وإعداد التقارير ومؤشرات الأداء . يفضل من لديه خبرة سابقة في العلامات التجارية الاستهلاكية أو المنتجات المنزلية أو قطاع التجزئة . متطلبات التقديم يرجى إرفاق السيرة الذاتية، مع ذكر أبرز العلامات التجارية التي سبق للمتقدم العمل عليها، وأمثلة على الحملات أو المشاريع التي ساهم في نجاحها، وتوضيح دوره والنتائج المحققة فيها .

b3ddbf15320be756.description: About Woc Technology Woc Technology, operating as World of Control (WOC), is a Saudi business that serves customers in the fire & safety, HVAC, CCTV/surveillance, and technology sectors. The company is seeking a dedicated professional to manage its digital marketing initiatives. The Role of SEO Specialist Woc Technology is looking for an SEO Specialist to plan and execute digital campaigns specifically targeting the Saudi market. This full-time role requires a hands-on approach to digital marketing, focusing on search engine optimization, content strategy, and paid advertising. Key Responsibilities Manage the SEO roadmap, including audits, keyword research, technical and on-page coordination, content optimization, and Search Console reporting. Plan and publish Arabic-first content across relevant social media platforms, coordinating creative assets and community responses. Set up, run, and optimize Google Ads and Meta campaigns within WOC-approved budgets. Oversee landing-page improvements and routine WordPress updates, ensuring appropriate access controls. Maintain GA4 and conversion tracking, along with a lead-source register. Provide weekly execution updates and monthly performance reports. Coordinate campaigns with the WOC sales team to measure qualified leads, lead quality, and conversion outcomes. Required Experience Candidates should have 3 to 5 years of experience in digital marketing, with a focus on SEO and campaign management. Work Type This is a full-time position.

b35bda5b990aadfb.description: About Berlitz Saudi Arabia Berlitz Saudi Arabia is part of the global Berlitz network, specializing in corporate training solutions. The company focuses on enhancing employee language and professional skills to improve communication and job-specific competencies, supporting business performance and international collaboration for organizations in Saudi Arabia. The Role of Customer Success Consultant Berlitz Saudi Arabia is seeking a Customer Success Consultant for a contract position in Makkah, with operations in Jeddah, Taif, and Al Hafuf. This role involves supporting the Language Center Director in achieving sales, revenue, customer acquisition, and customer retention targets, aligning with the Berlitz Learning Cycle. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Support the Language Center Director (LCD) in prospecting, lead generation, and qualification. Handle B2C sales inquiries received via telephone, online platforms, and walk-ins, and conduct sales interviews to meet sales and revenue targets. Prepare sales activity reports, including leads/prospects generated, sales call reports against leads/prospects, and conversion rates. Serve as the customer concierge at the Language Center, welcoming and assisting customers as needed. Conduct orientation sessions for new students. Coordinate with the LCD and CMI to ensure counseling sessions are scheduled and adhered to. Advise students on their end-of-level progress and identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling. Survey customers, collate results, and submit reports and recommendations to management. Address and resolve client inquiries, concerns, and feedback promptly and professionally. Identify areas for upselling and cross-selling, make recommendations to management, and implement actions accordingly. Ensure Language Center records are accurate and current at all times. Represent Berlitz KSA at events and collaborate with the marketing team on initiatives and campaigns. Complete additional job-related tasks as required by management. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field, demonstrating strong capabilities in customer success and sales support. This role requires an individual who can operate effectively in a dynamic, client-facing environment and contribute directly to business growth. Work Environment The team operates in a dynamic, client-facing environment, contributing to the growth and success of companies within Saudi Arabia. Professionals joining Berlitz KSA can expect a culture focused on learning, service excellence, and measurable results.

b3941c5dc9d97b68.description: About the Role RAWAJ is seeking a Recruitment Specialist – F&B to join its dynamic team. This full-time role is crucial for supporting talent acquisition and workforce planning within the Food & Beverage industry, with a particular focus on restaurant operations. The specialist will manage end-to-end recruitment processes, ensuring timely fulfillment of manpower requirements, especially for high-volume and specialized kitchen talent. Key Responsibilities Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for restaurant and F&B operations to meet manpower needs efficiently. Lead high-volume and mass recruitment initiatives, specifically for kitchen staff and culinary positions. Source, attract, and recruit chefs across various levels and specializations, including Executive Chefs, Head Chefs, Sous Chefs, Chef de Partie, Commis Chefs, and Sushi Chefs. Develop and maintain robust candidate pipelines to support ongoing recruitment and new restaurant openings. Collaborate with operations managers, restaurant managers, and executive chefs to understand staffing requirements and coordinate technical assessments and interviews. Utilize diverse recruitment channels such as LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, social media, and recruitment agencies. Monitor recruitment progress, maintain accurate candidate databases, and prepare regular recruitment reports. Support personnel affairs activities, including employee documentation, employment contracts, attendance, leave management, and onboarding processes. Ensure seamless coordination between recruitment and personnel functions for efficient hiring and onboarding. Required Qualifications and Experience Proven experience of 2-5 years in mass hiring and high-volume recruitment, particularly for chefs and kitchen teams. Strong understanding of restaurant operations and various kitchen positions and specializations. Hands-on experience managing the full recruitment cycle, from sourcing and screening to offer management and onboarding. Practical knowledge of personnel affairs and HR administration, including employee files, contracts, attendance, leave, and employment documentation. Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously and meet tight recruitment deadlines. Skills and Competencies Strong sourcing, communication, interviewing, and coordination skills. Proficiency with recruitment platforms and sourcing tools, including LinkedIn and various job portals. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b327f98090b68e0c.description: About TruKKer TruKKer is a logistics technology startup operating across the EMEA Region with over 700 employees and a presence in eleven countries, including KSA, UAE, India, Egypt, Bahrain, Jordan, Oman, Turkey, Poland, Kazakhstan, and China. Since its inception in 2016, TruKKer has expanded its platform to include approximately 75,000 trucks, serving over 1,200 enterprise clients with an annual revenue exceeding 300 million USD. The company focuses on organizing and digitizing the fragmented freight ecosystem to provide cost-efficient solutions. Role Summary TruKKer is seeking a Senior Key Account Manager for a full-time position in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This role involves managing and expanding a portfolio of key enterprise accounts within KSA, serving as the primary commercial and operational contact. The Senior Key Account Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth, maintaining margin discipline, and ensuring overall account health. Key Responsibilities Manage quotations, rate negotiations, and revenue delivery for assigned key accounts. Increase wallet share within existing accounts through proactive engagement and identifying new opportunities. Identify and secure new business to expand the account base and overall portfolio. Drive the upselling of additional services, lanes, and solutions to existing accounts. Maintain oversight of account-level margins, ensuring pricing aligns with profitability targets. Identify and address margin leakage in collaboration with pricing and commercial teams. Validate orders for key accounts to ensure accuracy and completeness before execution. Support the Operations team in collecting Proof of Delivery (POD) for assigned accounts. Act as an escalation point for billing or collection issues raised by clients, resolving disputes while maintaining client relationships. Serve as the single point of contact for assigned key accounts, building senior-level relationships. Conduct regular business reviews to monitor performance, resolve issues, and identify growth opportunities. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in key account management or a similar commercial role. Demonstrated ability to drive revenue growth and manage account profitability. Experience in negotiating rates and managing client relationships at a senior level. Strong understanding of operational processes and commercial discipline. Company Vision and Values TruKKer's vision is to be the most reliable partner in the freight ecosystem, powered by technology and sustainability. The company's mission is to provide cost-efficient freight solutions by organizing and digitizing the fragmented ecosystem. Core values include passion and hunger, customer-first approach, accountability, diversity and inclusion, cost-effectiveness, and honesty. Benefits and Opportunities Competitive salary and benefits package. Opportunity to contribute to a growing industry. A key role in the company's success in the Middle East region. Continuous learning and development opportunities, including mentorship from C-suite leaders. Involvement in the company's IPO journey. A diverse and inclusive work environment.

b3471546b63359c1.description: About Skyro Skyro is an international fintech group expanding its operations in Saudi Arabia. The company develops Sharia-compliant financing solutions designed to provide individuals and businesses with access to necessary funding. Skyro's B2B focus is on enhancing credit accessibility and simplicity for Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs) through technology and strategic partnerships. The Role of Senior Product Manager Skyro is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the development and expansion of its SME financing products in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves comprehensive ownership of the product lifecycle, from initial customer discovery and strategy formulation through to launch and continuous improvement. The Senior Product Manager will collaborate with local business teams and international technology teams. Key Responsibilities Lead product and feature development from concept through testing and launch. Translate customer and business requirements into clear product specifications and user stories. Coordinate efforts across local and international teams, resolve impediments, and make practical decisions. Establish and monitor product metrics including conversion, usage, repeat borrowing, and customer retention. Collaborate with Finance and Risk teams to understand profitability, acquisition, servicing costs, and credit losses. Utilize customer feedback, funnel analysis, and experiments to evaluate post-launch performance. Investigate performance issues with relevant teams and translate findings into actionable product improvements. Own and enhance the customer journey, covering application, onboarding, disbursement, repayment, and repeat borrowing. Identify friction points, streamline processes, and improve communication throughout the customer lifecycle. Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Sharia specialists to integrate regulatory and Sharia requirements into product design. Align customer journeys with credit policies, fraud controls, and operational processes. Conduct research with SME owners, suppliers, and partners to understand financing needs, business workflows, and barriers to credit access. Define the product roadmap, prioritizing initiatives based on customer value, business impact, and delivery effort. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will possess a strong combination of product judgment, analytical capabilities, and hands-on delivery experience. An understanding of lending principles and the specific needs of small businesses is essential for this role. Candidates should have 5-10 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose The Senior Product Manager will be instrumental in shaping and delivering SME financing products that effectively address customer needs and contribute to sustainable business growth. This role involves owning the product roadmap and customer experience, requiring a balance between commercial objectives, credit performance, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

b371ff50ebbdeaeb.description: About the Shopper & Customer Marketing Internship Beiersdorf is seeking a motivated and analytical Shopper & Customer Marketing Intern to join its commercial team. This full-time internship is based in Jeddah or Makkah, Makkah region, and is designed for individuals with 0-1 year of experience. The role focuses on connecting brand strategy with retailer execution, working closely with sales, category management, and vendors to influence the shopper journey. Key Responsibilities Support the Shopper & Customer Marketing team in executing commercial and shopper marketing initiatives. Assist in bridging the gap between brand strategy and retailer execution. Collaborate with Sales, Category Management, and external vendors. Contribute to the development and implementation of shopper-focused marketing programs. Help influence the shopper journey from initial awareness through to purchase. Analyze shopper and market data to support decision-making and assess campaign effectiveness. Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution at retail. Candidate Profile Education: Fresh university graduate with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business, or Economics. Experience: 0-1 year of experience. Competencies: Strong analytical and creative mindset. Attributes: Proactive attitude with an eagerness to learn quickly within a fast-paced FMCG/retail environment. About Beiersdorf Beiersdorf is a company dedicated to skin care, with a commitment extending beyond product development. For 140 years, Beiersdorf has created innovative skin and body care products for brands such as NIVEA, Eucerin, La Prairie, Hansaplast, and Labello. The company operates under the purpose WE CARE BEYOND SKIN, taking responsibility for consumers, employees, the environment, and society. With over 20,000 employees, Beiersdorf fosters an inclusive culture of respect and trust, aligned with its values: CARE, COURAGE, SIMPLICITY, and TRUST. The company values diversity and is committed to equal opportunities. Application Process For any inquiries regarding this position, please reach out to the Talent Acquisition team.

b3254cebccde5797.description: About Rayh RAʾYḤ | راية partners with Saudi companies to support their growth and innovation by developing new revenue streams. The company focuses on validating opportunities and then rapidly building and launching new ventures, often within 90 days. The founders have collectively generated over SAR 35 billion in enterprise value across Saudi Arabia and international markets. RAʾYḤ offers the opportunity to work closely with experienced builders on impactful projects that contribute to the future of businesses in the region. Role Overview: Business Development Manager The Business Development Manager is a full-time, on-site role located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This position is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and developing new business opportunities and strategic partnerships that align with RAʾYḤ’s venture-building model. The role requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Lead business development activities across multiple ventures, identify opportunities, and achieve sales and revenue targets. Manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, client meetings, proposals, negotiations, and closing deals. Develop and execute sales strategies tailored to each venture’s target market and business objectives. Establish and optimize Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), sales workflows, and customer journeys for each venture. Manage, coach, and develop Business Development Officers (BDOs), ensuring accountability and performance. Maintain an accurate CRM pipeline, monitor KPIs, and provide regular sales forecasts and performance reports. Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, partners, and decision-makers. Experience Requirements A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in business development or a related field. Demonstrated ability to identify and capitalize on new business opportunities. Proven track record in managing sales cycles and achieving revenue targets. Work Environment and Location This is an on-site position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a team focused on venture building and innovation for Saudi companies. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time Business Development Manager position.

b364b7b014aa7b11.description: About the Cooperative Training Program SABIC is offering a Cooperative Training Program for university and college students across its locations in Riyadh, Al Jubail, and Yanbu, Saudi Arabia. This internship program is designed for students seeking practical experience and professional development within a leading organization. The program aims to provide real workplace exposure and build a strong foundation for future career opportunities. Eligible Fields of Study The program welcomes students from a broad range of technical and administrative disciplines. These include, but are not limited to, various engineering fields, information technology, computer science, business administration, human resources, marketing, finance, and supply chain management. Training Experience During the training period, participants will engage in real projects and daily tasks, working closely with professional teams and mentors. This experience is intended to develop technical, administrative, and communication skills, providing valuable hands-on learning. Program Requirements Co-op training must be a graduation requirement from the applicant's university or college. Applicants must be nominated by their university or college, with an official COOP training letter required. A minimum cumulative GPA of * out of 4 or * out of 5 is required. Applicants must be medically fit. Applicants must not have graduated from their university or college prior to the program. Application Period The application window for this program will open on Monday, November 2, 2026, and will close on Sunday, November 15, 2026. Application Information Students who are motivated and eager to gain a training experience that supports their academic and professional journey are encouraged to apply for the upcoming Cooperative Training Program.

b3bd9e6712902bda.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الوطنية للتموين عن مدير مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الظهران. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف المباشر على أنشطة المبيعات وتخطيطها وتنظيمها لضمان تحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية المعتمدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في إعداد الأهداف الرئيسية والخطط التشغيلية والبرامج التنفيذية للمبيعات، وضمان تطبيقها والالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. الإشراف على الأنشطة اليومية للمبيعات، بما في ذلك ضبط أسعار البيع ومراقبة حركة المبيعات ومستوياتها لمختلف المنتجات والخدمات مقارنة بالخطط المالية. ضمان التنسيق الفعال مع شركاء العمل وبناء قاعدة عملاء واسعة، والتواصل المستمر معهم لجمع الملاحظات حول أساليب البيع والأسعار والعروض، وتقديم التقارير والتوصيات للإدارة العليا. متابعة وتوجيه عمليات إعداد التقارير والتحليلات الفنية لأنشطة المبيعات السابقة، ومراجعتها وعرضها على الإدارة العليا مع المقترحات والتوصيات المستندة إلى هذه التحليلات. الإشراف على أداء موظفي المبيعات وتوجيههم نحو أفضل أساليب وممارسات البيع، وضمان فهمهم لمواصفات المنتجات والخدمات، ومتابعة وتقييم أدائهم، وتوفير الموارد والتقنيات اللازمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال المبيعات أو دور إشرافي مماثل. القدرة على إعداد الخطط التشغيلية للمبيعات ومتابعة تنفيذها. مهارات قوية في تحليل بيانات المبيعات وتقديم التقارير. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل المنطقة الشرقية، الظهران. التقديم للمهتمين، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة في الوطنية للتموين.

b3c30d6be6f650a4.description: About the Role eXtra (United Electronics Co.) is seeking a Senior Internal Auditor to join its Internal Audit team. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern Region, and requires 4-5 years of relevant experience. The role involves leading and executing audit assignments to ensure compliance and identify control gaps within the organization. Key Responsibilities Lead and execute Operational, Financial, and Special Audit assignments with a focus on quality and independence. Conduct comprehensive risk assessments to identify key control gaps and prioritize audit areas. Develop audit programs, perform audit procedures, analyze evidence, and accurately document processes. b39c2df6689f812a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة نظم وقاية لأجهزة السلامة عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة القصيم، مع إمكانية العمل في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، حيث يركز على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى برامج التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الأعمال الميكانيكية، والتي تشمل المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية بناءً على تعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها بفعالية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة درجة علمية في الهندسة الميكانيكية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية. معرفة ببرامج تشغيل المعدات والصيانة الوقائية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق متخصص في مؤسسة نظم وقاية لأجهزة السلامة، ويساهم في تنفيذ المشاريع الهندسية في منطقة القصيم، بما في ذلك مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

b322aa6cc8845465.description: About the Role: Vehicle Inspection Specialist Soum is seeking a Vehicle Inspection Specialist to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role is central to ensuring the accuracy of vehicle condition assessments, as every car delivered by Soum must match its promised state. The specialist will be responsible for providing technical verification of each vehicle's condition, from initial inspection to final handover, and for diagnosing post-sale technical issues. Core Responsibilities and Objectives The primary objective of this role is to ensure that no vehicle leaves the showroom with undocumented defects, that all inspection reports are accurate and complete, and that technical issues are diagnosed promptly and routed for appropriate resolution. This is a technical position that supports the Cars Operations team and collaborates with After-Sales Customer Experience Specialists by providing clear, documented findings. Key Duties Conduct initial inspections of all vehicles, assessing body, exterior, interior, and overall condition against Soum's checklist. Evaluate mechanical and electrical components, including engine, transmission, suspension, brakes, steering, and electrical systems. Identify and document any damage, defects, previous repairs, or discrepancies. Produce clear and accurate inspection reports, including photographs of vehicle condition and identified defects. Record all findings, reports, and photos within the system for access by Sales and After-Sales teams. Perform final pre-handover inspections to confirm the vehicle matches its report and has not changed condition. Verify that all accessories (keys, manual, spare tire) are present before handover. Assess technical issues raised in post-sale warranty requests and complaints, determining cause and recommending fixes. Document technical findings for the After-Sales CX Specialist and escalate issues as needed. Brief maintenance workshops on technical findings and required work, then review completed repairs. Provide feedback on recurring defects to improve future inspection checklists. Coordinate with the Operations team throughout the vehicle journey and support other operational tasks. Performance Indicators Inspection coverage: Percentage of vehicles with a completed inspection report before handover. Report quality: Completeness of reports, including all checklist items and photos. Inspection accuracy: Number of post-sale complaints traced to missed defects. Pre-handover readiness: Number of handovers delayed due to technical or missing accessory issues. Technical assessment time: Time from case referral to documented technical finding. Repair verification: Percentage of workshop repairs checked and confirmed before case closure. Work Environment This is a full-time, technical role based in Riyadh, focusing on vehicle inspection and condition assessment. The specialist will work closely with the Cars Operations team and After-Sales Customer Experience Specialists, providing critical technical insights without direct customer interaction.

b30432eba0e1f40f.job_title: Business Support and Credit Collector (Saudi National)

b30acb12c4e494b6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخفجي، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تقييم تطور الحالات وفعالية العلاج المقدم. المسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية المفصلة من المريض وذويه، ودراسة الحالة المرضية بشكل شامل. إجراء الفحص السريري الدقيق وطلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية عند الحاجة. قراءة وتفسير نتائج الفحوصات والتقارير لتشخيص الحالة المرضية بدقة ضمن موضوع التخصص. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها خطوة بخطوة. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية ومدى فاعلية الخطة العلاجية المطبقة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمريض وحفظها بشكل منظم ودقيق. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي. شهادة جامعية في الطب مع تخصص ذي صلة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الخفجي بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة عمل داعمة ومحفزة في مجال طب الأسنان. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

b388604f1fa965df.description: 📢 إعلان وظيفي – مطلوب مندوبة مبيعات ميدانية في الرياض 🚗 شرط أساسي ومهم جدًا: امتلاك سيارة خاصة والقدرة على التنقل اليومي داخل مدينة الرياض. تعلن منصة أحجز (Ahjjz) المتخصصة في حجوزات قاعات الأفراح وخدمات المناسبات عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى: مندوبة – مبيعات ميدانية 📍 مقر العمل: الرياض 💰 الراتب والمميزات: الراتب خلال فترة التجربة: 4500ريال شهريًا. يرتفع الراتب إلى 5,000 ريال بعد اجتياز فترة التجربة بنجاح وتقييم الأداء. عمولات وحوافز إضافية مرتبطة بتحقيق المستهدفات. فرص للتطور الوظيفي والنمو مع المنصة. 📋 المهام الوظيفية: زيارة قاعات الأفراح والمناسبات في مدينة الرياض والتعريف بمنصة أحجز. استقطاب القاعات الجديدة وتسجيلها في المنصة. بناء علاقات مهنية مع ملاك القاعات ومديريها. استقطاب مزودي خدمات المناسبات مثل التصوير والضيافة والتنسيق وغيرها. شرح مميزات المنصة ونظام إدارة القاعات وإقناع العملاء بالاستفادة منه. متابعة القاعات المسجلة وتشجيعها على استخدام النظام بشكل فعّال. تحقيق مستهدفات الزيارات والتسجيلات والمبيعات. توثيق جميع الزيارات والاتصالات والمتابعات في نظام CRM. إعداد تقارير دورية عن الزيارات والنتائج والفرص المتاحة. ✅ الشروط والمتطلبات: امتلاك سيارة خاصة شرط أساسي لا يمكن الاستغناء عنه. الإقامة في مدينة الرياض. مهارات عالية في التواصل والإقناع والتفاوض. شخصية قوية، لبقة، ومظهر مهني لائق. الالتزام بالمواعيد والانضباط والدقة في العمل. القدرة على العمل الميداني وزيارة العملاء يوميًا. إجادة استخدام تطبيقات الجوال والأنظمة الإلكترونية. يفضّل وجود خبرة سابقة في المبيعات الميدانية أو تطوير الشراكات. القدرة على العمل باستقلالية وتحقيق الأهداف المطلوبة. 📩 للتقديم: يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية مع كتابة «وظيفة الرياض – مبيعات ميدانية»، وتوضيح مدى توفر سيارة خاصة. انضمي إلى فريق أحجز وساهمي معنا في تطوير قطاع المناسبات في المملكة العربية السعودية.

The Executive Director will establish the strategy, operating model and high-performing team for the department, while acting as Qiddiya’s principal representative to government entities, international sports federations, organising committees, rights holders and strategic partners for the planning and coordination of the major sporting events in the city. Internally, the role leads cross-functional collaboration to ensure Qiddiya is both development-ready and operationally ready to host world-class events. Key Responsibilities: Own the overarching strategy for the Sports SBU and Qiddiya’s role in in the planning and coordination of major games and events, defining objectives, priorities and measures of success aligned with Qiddiya strategy and Vision 2030. Ensure that every games and event programme advances Vision 2030 goals, including growing sports participation, enhancing quality of life, diversifying the economy, attracting tourism and investment, and positioning the Kingdom as a global sporting destination. Oversee the engagement framework for Qiddiya's role in delivering the Asian Games, the FIFA World Cup and future landmark global sporting events. Build the team, designing its organisational structure and resourcing plan, promoting a culture of excellence, collaboration, integrity and continuous improvement. Serve as Qiddiya's principal representative and senior point of contact with international sports federations, organising committees, event Organising Committee’s and other government and industry stakeholders for the planning and coordination of the major sporting events. Build, nurture and steward executive-level relationships with third parties, giving them a consistent, credible and trusted representation of Qiddiya always. Oversee comprehensive stakeholder engagement plans, mapping interests and influence and coordinating communication across internal and external parties. Manage cross-functional relationships across Qiddiya, so the organisation is coordinated and accountable for delivering the Asian Games, the FIFA World Cup and future landmark sporting events. Act as the strategic interface with key Qiddiya Governance and Event Oversight Committees, enabling effective cross-functional communication, collaboration and alignment across Strategic Business Units. Provide oversight Qiddiya's mater plan and venues, infrastructure and supporting facilities ensuring they are developed and delivered to event specifications, standards and timelines, working closely with the development and project delivery teams. Oversee integrated governance, planning and reporting mechanisms across internal functions to track event readiness, manage interdependencies and resolve issues early. Act as the central link between external event stakeholders and internal Qiddiya teams, translating host obligations and event requirements into clear internal priorities and actions. Oversee the department’s budget, forecasts and resource allocation, ensuring prudent financial stewardship. Regularly update senior management and the Board on strategy implementation, relationship status, event readiness, risks, opportunities and strategic recommendations. Champion a legacy-focused approach, ensuring that community benefit, fan experience and long-term destination value are built into Qiddiya's event contributions. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Real Estate Development, Events A minimum of 15+ years of senior leadership experience in major sporting events, sports governance, government relations, diplomacy or large-scale stakeholder management. Demonstrated involvement in the bidding, planning or delivery of multi-sport or mega-events such as the Olympic Games, FIFA World Cup, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games or equivalent. Proven track record of developing and executing organisational strategy at an executive level. Strong understanding of Saudi Vision 2030 and its sport, tourism and quality-of-life objectives, with the ability to translate national priorities into organisational and event strategy. Demonstrated experience building and scaling teams or new business units, including organisational design, recruitment and talent development. Proven experience leading cross-functional programs and driving development and operational readiness for major venues, events or destinations. An established network and proven credibility with international sports federations, governing bodies, governments and senior industry leaders. Gravitas and a commanding executive presence, with exceptional diplomatic, negotiation and representational skills at board, ministerial and international levels. Strong understanding of host city agreements, event governance structures, commercial rights and legacy planning. Exceptional leadership, communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to handle politically and culturally sensitive environments. Ability to work collaboratively with diverse stakeholders and adapt to a rapidly changing environment

b33961ca97cd44b0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة المشاريع الراقيه الخاصه للمقاولات عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ سياسات واستراتيجيات المبيعات، ومتابعة الأداء، وتقييم النتائج لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع، وتقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع، وترجمة هذه الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، وتقييم البرامج الترويجية لضمان فعاليتها. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد مشكلاتهم واحتياجاتهم، ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المحتملة. تقييم أداء مندوبي المبيعات ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية عند الضرورة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل السوق وتحديد الفرص البيعية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتفاعل مع العملاء والزملاء. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات قوية في التخطيط والتنظيم. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتحليل البيانات. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي المبيعات بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق يدعم تحقيق الأهداف البيعية للمؤسسة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

b3348cc5c1fbdea1.description: About the Role HanmiGlobal is seeking a Risk Manager to join its program management and PMCM team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the program-wide risk management framework and mitigation strategies for a significant multi-work package land and infrastructure development program. The program is delivered on behalf of a major government entity in Riyadh. Key Responsibilities The Risk Manager will provide program-level leadership, governance, coordination, and strategic risk oversight for all risk and opportunity management activities. This includes ensuring that risk identification, assessment, mitigation tracking, and reporting are integrated into planning, project controls, design, construction, and interface management to support informed decision-making and successful program delivery. Establish and maintain the Program Risk Management Framework, Plan, procedures, standards, methodologies, and reporting requirements. Lead program-wide risk identification activities and structured risk workshops, facilitating the identification of strategic, technical, commercial, schedule, cost, interface, quality, HSE, stakeholder, and regulatory risks. Support the development and maintenance of package and program risk registers, assessing probability, impact, exposure, and criticality of identified risks and opportunities. Coordinate the development of risk mitigation, response, contingency, and monitoring plans, tracking implementation effectiveness, emerging risks, and residual risks. Escalate significant risks affecting program objectives, milestones, budgets, approvals, or delivery commitments, and monitor risk ownership and accountability. Coordinate with various managers (Planning & Scheduling, Project Control, Senior Commercial, Interface, Technical, Design, Quality, and HSE) regarding specific risk categories and mitigation measures. Lead qualitative and quantitative risk analysis activities, monitor program risk exposure and trends, and prepare risk reports, dashboards, and presentations. Promote the identification and assessment of opportunities to improve cost, schedule, quality, operational performance, sustainability, or delivery outcomes. Facilitate risk workshops, review meetings, lessons learned sessions, and stakeholder coordination meetings. Support continuous improvement in risk management practices, implementation of PMIS and risk management software, and knowledge management initiatives. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess a strong background in risk management within large-scale development programs. Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Risk Management, Quantity Surveying, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Membership of a recognized Chartered Professional Institution relevant to the discipline or an approved equivalent. Over 15 years of demonstrated experience in enterprise risk management, project risk management, infrastructure delivery, urban development, major capital projects, or mega-programs. Experience in PMCM, PMC, EPCM, consultancy, developer, contractor, or client-side organizations. Experience within Saudi Arabia and/or the GCC region is preferred. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, working within HanmiGlobal's program management and PMCM team. The role involves engagement with a major government entity and coordination across multiple program packages.

b341f50f1f78c167.description: About the Role DP World Jeddah is seeking an experienced Vessel Planner Advance Planning to join their Planning team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for optimizing vessel stowage and crane planning to enhance vessel productivity, berth performance, and overall terminal efficiency. Key Responsibilities Review vessel profiles, ship structures, stack weights, reefer slots, hatch covers, and vessel limitations to validate planning inputs and identify constraints. Analyze BAPLIE, MOVINS, TOS data, and other planning information; investigate discrepancies, assess operational impact, and coordinate resolutions with stakeholders. Develop, validate, and optimize vessel stowage plans and crane programs in line with vessel stability, cargo requirements, terminal equipment capability, and operational procedures. Identify opportunities to improve twin lift, tandem lift, dual cycling, and other crane-planning methods, subject to vessel design, equipment capability, and safety requirements. Analyze crane intensity, bay gaps, heavy hooks, crane sequences, and workload balance; recommend plan changes to improve crane and berth productivity. Evaluate special and sensitive cargo requirements, including reefer, OOG, IMDG, breakbulk, and direct deliveries, ensuring plans incorporate necessary restrictions. Validate consistency between planning systems, identify data-quality issues, and coordinate corrective actions with IT/TOS and planning stakeholders. Coordinate with Central Planner, Dynamic Vessel Planners, Yard Planners, Operations, and vessel representatives to align optimized plans with yard capacity and terminal strategy. Monitor vessel-plan execution, compare planned versus actual performance, analyze causes of productivity loss, and recommend corrective actions. Support planning for complex vessel calls, major plan changes, and disrupted schedules by assessing alternatives, trade-offs, and risks. Ensure stowage plans, crane plans, and container weight lists (CWL) are reviewed and approved by the Chief Officer and authorized planning representatives. Maintain planning standards, optimization guidelines, analysis records, and vessel-specific lessons learned; coach Dynamic Vessel Planners on planning quality. Support TOS enhancements, planning tools, data-quality improvements, and continuous improvement initiatives. Provide supervisors and management with concise analysis of vessel-plan quality, productivity opportunities, and operational risks. Ensure compliance with HSE policy, Fatal Risk Standards, Safe Work Practices, and relevant SOPs; escalate safety or stability risks immediately. Systematically identify and document available crane-productivity opportunities before vessel arrival. Prepare the loading plan in accordance with approved stowage instructions, ensuring accessible picking points and practical bay sequences. Develop and optimize vessel loading and discharge sequences, balancing crane productivity, cargo priorities, and operational constraints. Act as the planning focal point for coordinating loading and discharge sequences (Quay Commander function, where assigned). Obtain and record the shipping line’s approval of the loading plan before implementation and coordinate any required revisions. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Maritime Studies, Naval/Marine-related disciplines, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field. Experience: 4+ years in container-terminal operations, including substantial vessel-planning experience and demonstrated capability in complex stowage or crane planning. Work Environment The role requires willingness to work day/night or general shifts, weekends, public holidays, and overtime as required under company policy and applicable labor laws.

b3d271d195e97492.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة بشكل كامل، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم القائمة. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتعلقة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء (HVAC). القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. معرفة جيدة بمعايير الجودة والمواد المستخدمة في أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف ضمن فريق متخصص في مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات بالمنطقة الشرقية، الدمام. الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية في جميع الأوقات. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للنظر فيها.

b3e652708d472f48.description: Data Analyst Specialist at Namaa Partners Namaa Partners is seeking a Data Analyst Specialist to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. b3e7fcf492665b38.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة حبوب القهوة عن حاجتها لـ مدير حسابات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى مدير الحسابات الإشراف على جميع الأنشطة المحاسبية والمالية التشغيلية للشركة، لضمان دقة وسلامة السجلات والبيانات المالية. يهدف الدور إلى تعزيز الضوابط المالية وحماية أصول الشركة، مع ضمان الامتثال الكامل للمعايير الدولية لإعداد التقارير المالية (IFRS) والقوانين والمتطلبات التنظيمية المعمول بها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على العمليات المحاسبية اليومية ومراجعة قيود اليومية والتسويات المالية. إدارة عمليات الإغلاق المالي الشهرية والربع سنوية والسنوية، وإعداد ومراجعة البيانات المالية وتقارير الإدارة. الإشراف على حسابات دفتر الأستاذ العام ودليل الحسابات، ومراجعة موازين المراجعة وأرصدة الحسابات. مراقبة أداء فريق المحاسبة وضمان دقة البيانات المالية واكتمال المستندات الداعمة. الإشراف على حسابات العملاء والموردين، بما في ذلك أرصدة الحسابات والتسويات، ومراقبة التحصيلات والمدفوعات. الإشراف على محاسبة المخزون وحسابات تكلفة البضاعة المباعة، ومراجعة جرد المخزون. الإشراف على إعداد ومراجعة إقرارات الزكاة والضرائب، وضمان الامتثال للقوانين واللوائح المعمول بها في المملكة العربية السعودية. تنفيذ السياسات المالية المعتمدة وإجراءات الرقابة الداخلية، ودعم عمليات التدقيق الداخلي والخارجي. الإشراف على دقة البيانات المالية والمعاملات المحاسبية ضمن نظام تخطيط موارد المؤسسات (ERP). توزيع المسؤوليات على فريق المحاسبة، ومراقبة الأداء، وتدريب الموظفين b31e6d9ab7973d65.description: The Planning and Budgeting Advisor is responsible for providing strategic financial advice, facilitating budget planning, and ensuring the alignment of financial resources with the university’s objectives. This role supports decision-making by delivering accurate financial analysis, forecasting, and budgetary guidance to various administrative and operational units. The advisor collaborates closely with the Campus and community department manager, management, and finance teams to optimize resource allocation and manage operational expenditures (OPEX) and capital expenditures (CAPEX). Responsibilities Provide financial forecasting, analysis, and reporting to support strategic decision-making for Campus and community department. Ensure alignment of budgetary plans with Campus and Community goals and priorities. Strong understanding of budgeting, financial planning, and forecasting processes. Prepare detailed financial reports, variance analyses, and cost assessments for both OPEX and CAPEX. Ensure effective management of operational expenditures by identifying potential efficiencies and cost reductions. Monitor budget performance and provide regular updates on financial status, risks, and opportunities. Analyze financial trends and identify cost-saving opportunities while ensuring resource optimization. Work closely with Campus and community units to gather budget inputs and provide guidance on financial planning processes. Advise leadership on budget policies, financial planning strategies, and funding requirements. Recommend appropriate adjustments to budgets and resource allocation in response to operational needs or external factors. Assist in financial scenario planning and risk management for strategic projects and initiatives. Proficiency in financial modeling, variance analysis, and cost control methods. Capability to identify cost-saving opportunities and efficiencies within budgetary constraints. Ability to align financial planning with the university’s strategic goals and priorities. Expertise in long-term financial scenario planning, risk assessment, and contingency planning. Ability to analyze complex financial data, interpret trends, and provide recommendations to optimize resource allocation. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. Professional certifications such as Advanced Financial Management are advantageous and desirable. Advanced proficiency in financial software and tools (e.g., ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, or PeopleSoft). 5 years of experience in budgeting, financial planning, or advisory roles, preferably within a higher education or non-profit setting. Proven experience in managing and reporting on both operational (OPEX) and capital expenditure (CAPEX) budgets. Experience working in a collaborative, multi-stakeholder environment with exposure to large-scale budget management. Strong command of Microsoft Excel for financial modelling, data analysis, and forecasting. Familiarity with business intelligence tools and financial reporting software (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

b39cd0d8beb047ba.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة الانشاءات وخدمات الطرق للمقاولات العامه لصاحبها/حمد عب عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل العمليات المحاسبية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المالية اللازمة. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في المجال. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها. معرفة بإعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية. مهارات في تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها. بيئة العمل يعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق في مؤسسة الانشاءات وخدمات الطرق للمقاولات العامه لصاحبها/حمد عب في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بالمهام المالية والمحاسبية اليومية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة في الدمام.

b3cc228fa997d48d.description: Job description Job Title: Chief Specialist – Acceleration Asset Ramp-up Reporting To: Director, Technology Development Business Unit / Function: Technology & Innovation Department: Technology Enablement Grade: M13 Why This Role Matters The Chief Specialist – Acceleration Asset Ramp-up exists to help Ma’aden bring mining and processing assets to stable, productive operation faster. The role connects technology, operational expertise, data and analytics to address the constraints that slow commissioning, stabilization and early operational performance. The role creates value by identifying the highest-impact opportunities across throughput, recovery, uptime, cost and production readiness, then translating them into practical interventions that accelerate performance improvement. It provides an enterprise perspective across assets, enabling successful approaches to be reused rather than solved independently at each operation. Working across Operations, Technology & Innovation, Data & AI and project stakeholders, the role strengthens the transition from commissioning to reliable operations and embeds repeatable approaches that improve the performance of future asset ramp-ups. What You Will Deliver Asset Ramp-up & Performance Shape and embed an enterprise approach to asset ramp-up that shortens the path from commissioning to stable operations across mining and processing assets. Identify and activate the critical throughput, recovery, uptime, cost and readiness levers that accelerate early-stage asset performance. Diagnose systemic ramp-up constraints and enable focused interventions that address root causes and protect production value. Value Realization Translate ramp-up opportunities into measurable value hypotheses, performance targets and interventions with clear ownership and benefit tracking. Drive sustained improvements in ramp-up speed, asset utilization and operational readiness through fact-based performance management. Provide actionable insights that enable leadership to prioritize interventions and investments against the areas of greatest operational value. Digital & Analytics Enablement Accelerate the application of advanced analytics, digital twins and predictive capabilities where they improve commissioning, stabilization and ramp-up decisions. Embed relevant digital capabilities into operational workflows to strengthen real-time visibility, decision quality and performance management. Enable repeatable ramp-up use cases to scale across assets in partnership with technology, data and solution teams. Enterprise Execution & Governance Orchestrate alignment across Operations, Technology & Innovation, Data & AI, projects and commissioning stakeholders to resolve cross-functional dependencies and barriers. Establish consistent governance, performance measures and executive-level visibility across priority ramp-up initiatives. Strengthen the transition between project, commissioning and operational teams through clear performance expectations and integrated execution. Standards & Organizational Capability Develop and embed scalable ramp-up playbooks, tools and practices appropriate to different asset classes and operating environments. Convert lessons from asset ramp-ups into reusable organizational knowledge that improves subsequent commissioning and stabilization. Build organizational capability through technical coaching, knowledge transfer and adoption of proven ramp-up practices. What Success Looks Like Reduced time from commissioning to stable and targeted operating performance. Improved throughput, recovery, uptime and asset utilization during ramp-up. Measurable value realized from prioritized digital, analytics and operational interventions. Reduced recurrence of ramp-up constraints through effective root-cause resolution and reuse of lessons learned. Increased adoption of standardized ramp-up methods, playbooks and proven use cases across applicable assets. Stronger visibility of ramp-up performance, risks and value realization to enable faster management decisions. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Mining, Metallurgy, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline. Master’s degree in a relevant discipline is advantageous. Experience 12–15+ years of relevant experience in mining, mineral processing or comparable heavy industry environments. Significant exposure to asset commissioning, operational ramp-up, stabilization and performance improvement. Experience delivering operational value through digital, analytics or technology-enabled improvement initiatives. Experience working across multidisciplinary operational, technical, project and technology stakeholders. Skills That Matter Asset ramp-up and commissioning optimization Mining and processing operational excellence Production performance and bottleneck analysis Advanced analytics and digital enablement Value realization and benefits management Performance management and KPI design Strategic problem-solving Cross-functional execution Senior stakeholder influencing Change and capability building Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

b34de432d155c45f.description: About Misk Schools Misk Schools is an educational institution located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. b330ea0c8f91ace7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن أمين صندوق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإدارة المالية والتخطيط، ويشمل إدارة التدفقات النقدية والسيولة والتمويل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، ويهدف إلى ضمان الكفاءة المالية وتحليل المخاطر المرتبطة بالسيولة وأسعار الفائدة والعملات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الأرصدة النقدية اليومية وتحليل التدفق النقدي من العمليات والاستثمار والتمويل. ضمان كفاية التدفقات النقدية وتوقع المدفوعات النقدية والتنبؤ بالمشكلات المحتملة الناتجة عن محدودية التدفق النقدي. تحليل متطلبات رأس المال في العمليات التجارية والمعاملات والالتزامات الأخرى. تقديم الدعم في وضع سياسات وإجراءات الرقابة الداخلية المتعلقة بإدارة الموازنة والنقد والائتمان والمحاسبة. تحليل وإدارة المخاطر المرتبطة بالتدفقات النقدية، وإجراء تحليل الحساسية لتقييم تقلبات التدفقات النقدية فيما يتعلق بالمخاطر التشغيلية والتمويلية. تحليل وتحديد خيارات شروط التمويل لتتناسب مع الاحتياجات التشغيلية والاستثمارية، والسعي للحصول على مصادر التمويل والتفاوض حول شروطها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إدارة التخطيط المالي وتحليل التدفقات النقدية. فهم جيد لمبادئ السيولة والتمويل. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم السيولة وأسعار الفائدة ومخاطر العملة. القدرة على التنبؤ بالمشكلات المالية وتقديم الحلول. مهارات التفاوض للحصول على مصادر التمويل. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتقديم الدعم في وضع السياسات المالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في إدارة الشؤون المالية لشركة معين للموارد البشرية. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

b3358cf7377c9622.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تداوي الطبية عن صيدلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتحضير التركيبات الدوائية، وإدارة مخزون الصيدلية، وصرف الأدوية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق الطبية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مواصفات وتركيبات الأدوية والعقاقير والمواد الصيدلانية، وتحضيرها وصرفها وفقاً للوصفات الطبية. تحديد الآثار الجانبية المحتملة لاستخدام الأدوية وتأثيراتها على الإنسان. تحديد احتياجات الصيدلية من الأدوية والعلاجات، وإعداد طلبات الشراء ومتابعة توفيرها واستلامها وتخزينها حسب الأسس الصيدلانية. مراجعة الوصفات الطبية وتجهيز الدواء قبل صرفه للمستهلك، وتقديم الإرشادات اللازمة للمريض حول طريقة الاستعمال والآثار الجانبية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال الصيدلة. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالصيدلة في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الصيدلة. القدرة على دراسة التركيبات الدوائية وتحضيرها. معرفة بإجراءات تخزين الأدوية وصرفها. بيئة العمل يعمل الصيدلي بدوام كامل في مدينة جازان، ضمن فريق شركة تداوي الطبية، ويساهم في تقديم رعاية صيدلانية عالية الجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

b3d4a77f9cd779f7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ايوان للتجارة عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تطبيق قوانين ولوائح السلامة والصحة المهنية، والتحقيق في الحوادث، وإعداد الإجراءات والتقارير اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل وتسجيل النتائج ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. تجهيز معدات وأجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز، وتوثيق النتائج ومتابعة معالجة الأخطار. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيق وتوثيق النتائج. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن والإخلاء، وتوعية العاملين بها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بالسلامة. مهارات في قياس العوامل البيئية وتحليل البيانات. القدرة على التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات وإعداد التقارير. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور العمل ضمن فريق لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالتقديم، يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية.

b33de2f971f11297.description: About Lifera Omics Lifera Omics is a precision medicine laboratory focused on delivering high-complexity multiomics diagnostics. The company aims to advance clinical omics in the region through technology, quality systems, and scientific leadership. The Role: ABMGG Board Certified Molecular Geneticist Lifera Omics is expanding its clinical reporting capabilities and is seeking an ABMGG Board Certified Molecular Geneticist to join its multidisciplinary team. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will contribute to clinical reporting, variant interpretation, and quality oversight across various multi-omics platforms. Key Responsibilities Provide clinical interpretation and sign-out for high-complexity molecular genetic tests, including Whole-Genome Sequencing (WGS), Whole-Exome Sequencing (WES), targeted Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS), Copy Number Variation (CNV), and RNA-seq. Apply established standards such as ACMG/AMP, ClinGen, and CAP/CLIA for variant classification and reporting. Collaborate with clinical geneticists, bioinformaticians, and laboratory directors to ensure accurate, timely, and high-quality reports. Participate in assay validation, quality management, and continuous improvement initiatives. Contribute to the development of new diagnostic assays and multi-omics reporting frameworks. Support multidisciplinary case discussions and clinical consultations. Mentor junior scientists and contribute to professional development within the genomics team. Platforms and Technologies The role involves working with advanced multi-omics platforms, including whole-genome sequencing, exome sequencing, RNA-seq, methylation profiling, and targeted NGS assays. This position offers involvement with cutting-edge multi-omics technologies and high-impact clinical programs. Work Environment and Contribution This role is situated within one of the region’s advanced precision medicine laboratories. The Molecular Geneticist will contribute to large-scale national genomics initiatives and work within a multidisciplinary team of clinical scientists, bioinformaticians, and medical geneticists. Compensation and Growth Lifera Omics offers competitive compensation and opportunities for leadership growth within the organization.

b3fba3d1d6e316ca.description: About Tumodo Tumodo is a global technology startup focused on simplifying business travel. The company offers a unified platform for bookings, expenses, travel policies, approvals, and insights, with integration into HR and Finance systems. Tumodo aims to address travel friction for organizations. About the Role: Partnerships Manager Tumodo is seeking a Partnerships Manager to build and expand its partner ecosystem in Saudi Arabia and the UAE. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focuses on driving revenue through strategic partnerships rather than solely brand awareness. The successful candidate will identify, onboard, and activate partners across various platforms, including HR/HCM, ERP systems, fintech providers, payroll solutions, procurement platforms, and system integrators. The primary objective is to establish partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue as a key growth channel for Tumodo in the region. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience and involves working towards clear commercial goals with a focus on pipeline generation and measurable revenue growth. Key Responsibilities Design tiered partner programs, including benefits, marketing development funds (MDF), service level agreements, and commercial terms. Identify, vet, and negotiate partnerships with ISVs, VARs, system integrators, and marketplace platforms. Create co-sell frameworks for partner sales teams, including deal kits, battlecards, ROI calculators, and sales enablement materials. Develop joint go-to-market strategies and value propositions tailored for KSA buyers (HR Directors, CFOs, Procurement, Travel Managers). Plan and execute co-marketing campaigns such as webinars, events, PR initiatives, and content syndication with measurable pipeline targets. Run account-based and geo-targeted partner campaigns with localized landing pages and lead capture mechanisms. Organize field events (roadshows, trade fairs in Riyadh/Jeddah) with partners, managing messaging, collateral, and post-event pipeline follow-up. Prioritize product integrations that accelerate customer adoption with key platforms (*, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Odoo, Zoho, Jisr, Qoyod, payment wallets). Coordinate beta testing cohorts, create launch messaging, and manage in-product placement strategies. Produce bilingual release notes, one-pagers, and customer success stories in Arabic and English. Manage MDF/OPA budgets and partner revenue forecasts. Report weekly on partner-sourced pipeline, deal velocity, customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, and annual recurring revenue (ARR). Ensure accurate marketing attribution in HubSpot/GA4 and maintain pipeline hygiene. Ensure compliance with PDPL (KSA Personal Data Protection Law) and local marketing regulations. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated strategic and analytical capabilities in partnerships. Ability to drive revenue through partner ecosystems. Work Environment and Benefits This role offers the opportunity to lead a critical growth area within one of Tumodo's fastest-growing markets, with significant ownership and visibility across leadership. As Tumodo expands in the Middle East, there will be opportunities for regional scope expansion. The company provides a competitive salary and benefits, potential for rapid advancement, and a collaborative culture that supports success and development. Tumodo is an equal-opportunity employer, valuing diversity, inclusion, and open collaboration.

b3b5733e10cc8417.description: We are looking for a Data Analyst to transform raw operational and transactional data into actionable insights that support business decisions and improve operational performance. The ideal candidate has strong SQL skills, advanced Google Sheets expertise, and the ability to translate business requirements into meaningful analysis, reports, and dashboards. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to identify trends, investigate performance issues, and support data-driven decision-making. Key Responsibilities Write advanced SQL queries using CTEs, window functions, and multi-table joins to extract, aggregate, and analyze large datasets. Build and maintain dynamic dashboards, forecasting models, and operational trackers using Google Sheets. Conduct root-cause analysis, identify trends, and investigate operational performance issues. Define and monitor KPIs to measure business and operational performance. Translate business requests into structured data models and actionable insights. Present analytical findings and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership. Develop automated audit checks to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and quality. Support continuous improvement through data-driven recommendations. 2–3 years of experience in Data Analytics or Business Intelligence. At least 2 years of hands-on experience writing advanced SQL queries. Strong SQL knowledge, including CTEs, window functions, and complex joins. Advanced Google Sheets skills, including QUERY, IMPORTRANGE, ARRAYFORMULA, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, and dynamic Pivot Tables. Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker Studio or Power BI. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills. Experience working with databases such as BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Snowflake. Excellent English communication skills; professional Arabic is strongly preferred. Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is preferred.

In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing our HRIS capabilities to support effective HR operations and enhance the overall employee experience. Collaborate with IT and external vendors to ensure system reliability and address technical issues promptly. Facilitate training sessions for HR staff and end-users on system processes and best practices. Support project management for HRIS-related initiatives and work closely with various stakeholders to ensure alignment with HR strategy. Strong knowledge of HRIS functionality and applications. Proficiency in data management and reporting tools, including Excel and HR analytics software.
