Effective communication skills to interact with HR staff and employees at all levels. Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. Proactive approach to learning and adapting to new tools and technologies. Desire to contribute to the development and optimization of HR processes through technology. Comprehensive benefits package

b3290a51269602bd.description: We are looking for a detail-oriented and dependable Electrical / Mechanical Technician to support our engineering, manufacturing, laboratory, and workshop activities. The successful candidate will be responsible for equipment maintenance, fabrication, assembly, testing, troubleshooting, workshop operations, and supporting project requirements. The role requires strong practical skills, the ability to work from engineering drawings and instructions, and a hands-on approach to solving technical problems. Key Responsibilities Support the management in sourcing and outsourcing CNC machine parts and related components. Perform fabrication and assembly of metallic and non-metallic parts using drawings, sketches, and verbal instructions. Support the realization, assembly, and testing of electrical systems . Support manufacturing, fabrication, assembly, and testing activities for ongoing projects. Perform maintenance of workshop and laboratory equipment and manage materials, tools, and other resources. Liaise with suppliers and contractors regarding the servicing, repair, maintenance, and testing of laboratory and workshop equipment. Manage company assets through equipment and tool tagging . Maintain accurate records of asset movement within laboratory and workshop areas. Maintain up-to-date records of equipment maintenance, inspection, and testing . Assist in sourcing materials, consumables, tools, and equipment required for mechanical laboratories and workshop activities. Evaluate and test new equipment and tools being considered for laboratory and workshop use. Support technical staff in developing laboratory demonstrations, prototypes, and project activities. Maintain laboratory and workshop equipment to ensure efficient changeover between projects and demonstrations. Perform equipment troubleshooting and assist in diagnosing technical problems. Ensure compliance with all applicable HSE requirements, procedures, and safe working practices . Support company outreach activities with partners, customers, and collaborators. Perform other duties assigned by the Head of Department that are appropriate to the role. DAE / Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Good practical knowledge of workshop tools and equipment. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to handle multiple tasks and requests in a professional, calm, and organized manner. Good teamwork and communication skills.

b3f9506f48b46b5f.description: We are looking for a skilled Industrial Electronics Technician responsible for installing, troubleshooting, repairing, calibrating, and maintaining electronic systems and industrial control equipment. The role requires strong hands-on experience with electronic circuits, instrumentation, control systems, and industrial electrical/electronic equipment. Key Responsibilities Install, inspect, test, troubleshoot, and repair industrial electronic equipment and control systems. Diagnose faults in electronic circuits, PLC systems, sensors, controllers, transmitters, and related equipment. Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electronic and instrumentation systems. Read and interpret electrical/electronic schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical drawings. Test electronic components using multimeters, oscilloscopes, signal generators, and other diagnostic equipment. Calibrate and maintain sensors, transmitters, controllers, and other measurement devices. Troubleshoot PLC I/O systems, control panels, variable frequency drives (VFDs), and industrial automation equipment. Identify faulty components and perform component-level or board-level repairs where applicable. Maintain accurate records of inspections, repairs, maintenance activities, and equipment performance. Support installation and commissioning of new electronic and control equipment. Ensure all work complies with applicable safety procedures, technical standards, and site requirements. Coordinate with electrical, instrumentation, maintenance, and operations teams to resolve equipment issues. Maintain tools, test equipment, spare parts, and technical documentation. Diploma or Technical Certificate in Electronics, Industrial Electronics, Instrumentation, Electrical Engineering , or a related field. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience as an Industrial Electronics Technician, Electronics Technician, Instrument Technician, or similar role. Hands-on experience troubleshooting industrial electronic and control systems. Good knowledge of electronic components, circuits, sensors, control systems, and instrumentation. Experience with PLC systems, VFDs, control panels, and industrial automation is preferred. Ability to read electrical/electronic schematics and technical drawings. Experience using electronic testing and diagnostic instruments. Knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance practices. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
